meta.description: A 15-item yes/no scale. Each depressive answer scores 1 point (total 0–15).

items.prompt: Recently, do you often feel low in mood or lacking in energy? (Yes/No)
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy? (Yes/No)
Do you often feel that being alone is easier than being with others? (Yes/No)
Do you often feel lonely and have few people to talk to? (Yes/No)
Recently, do you often worry about your health so much that it affects your mood? (Yes/No)
Do you feel that every day is about the same and there is little to look forward to? (Yes/No)
Do you become easily irritated or annoyed by small things? (Yes/No)
Do you often feel that you are a burden to your family or others? (Yes/No)
Does your worsening memory bother or upset you? (Yes/No)
Recently, do you find it hard to calm down and enjoy any activity? (Yes/No)
Do you often sleep poorly and still feel tired after waking up? (Yes/No)
Do you feel less willing than before to go out or meet friends? (Yes/No)
Do you often dwell on unhappy events or thoughts? (Yes/No)
Do you feel that others care about you less than before? (Yes/No)
Do you sometimes feel that life is not very meaningful? (Yes/No)
